name: Barkleaf Journal
description: A field journal of layered bark-paper leaves bound in a weather-resistant Thornfiber wrap. The pages take stain and resin-pigment cleanly, hold up to damp under canopy, and resist tearing when carried in active fieldwork. Standard issue for elven foragers, Heartwarden investigators, and grove-warden recordkeepers.
narrative_effects: Supports journaling, route marking, plant observation, and specimen records under field conditions.
Resists damp and rough handling far better than realm parchment or paper; sustains legibility across long forest journeys.
Pairs with a Resinpoint Stylus as the standard elven field-recordkeeping kit.
